The future of our nation (and the game) is in your hands.

Please feel free to make overly impassioned speeches.

Types of government include:

A true democracy: Every issue is voted on by every person. 
Pro: The individual gets a hand in shaping the future.
Con: The court of public opinion will directly change how the government works.
Wealth: capitalistic.

A republic: A group of people represent the rest of the people and take care of the issues.
Pro: An organized group of people with checks and balances govern and can be removed from power.
Con: The group of people will be easily influenced by the people with the most money.
Wealth: Capitalistic

A monarchy: A single leader holds wealth and provides goods to those who provide services. The nation gets divided in to a feudal system where each state is it's own kingdom.

Pro: With enough violence you can become king. And then claim that a higher power wants your child and every firstborn there after also be a king.
Con: You likely wont be a king.
Wealth: Centralized by taxation.

Socialism: Everything belongs to the government to be redistributed to everyone equally. A group of leaders controls the infrastructure. From roads to manufacturing, every part of life is controlled by the rulers.

Pros: Life generally gets taken care of for you, and people are generally treated as equals. A farmer is paid the same as a doctor.
Cons: There is a cap on how successful you can be before the government owns what you have made to distribute it as common property. 
Wealth: Individual with a cap.

Communism: Everything belongs to everyone, and there is no social class system. The country is united with no political parties. Everyone has a job and an education.

Pro: No one is born with a material advantage over you. Everyone starts life equal. There is no wealthy elite. Your bills will be non existent.

Con: A centralized government which controls all of the wealth of a state can be corrupted into think of the state as their opportunity for capitalism. Because all science, manufacturing, military and agriculture is controlled by one entity, it is essentially an all powerful government that can wield the countries' resources any way it chooses.  

Wealth: none.

Oligarchy: The purist form of capitalism, the country is literally controlled by companies.

Pro: Science, technology manufacturing and agriculture are typically at the forefront and highly competitive  and advancements are the focus.

Con: There is a rigid caste system that forces the average worker to be impoverished and dependent on the company for both goods and wealth. Wealth is seen as the most important feature of a person's life.

Wealth: Low potential for high wealth. 

Meritocracy: A system of government in which the most qualified are the ruling class. Every job, every penny you earn is based on your ability to do that job.

Pro: Ideally the people most competent at running the country will do so. As will every major position.

Con: for those on the lower half of the bell curve of being skilled, you are valueless unless you improve.
